turns.transcript: This is Jonas calling from Caffè Berlin.
We have a Marea 2 Plus, the Vaniglia edition.
The coffee comes out thin and fast.
Last year we ordered the group gasket.
The code is GE-2140. We also need the shower screen.

GE-2150. For the heating element, the invoice says CA-1180. The control board is EL-3010, and the pump is ID-4010. The steam valve seal kit is VA-5015. In the other shop we have a Giglio 1 Plus and a Monda 65 Digit grinder.
The burrs are MC-7010, and the Onda MB2 has a probe alarm.
